voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: Hindi ka makagalaw. At may nakadagan sa dibdib mo.
lines.beat_before: hook: his POV on the banig, the ceiling; a vast dark shape leans in from the edge; the frame is pressed down

lines.text: Sa mga Ilokano, may tinatawag na batibat. Isang matandang espiritu na nakatira sa puno.
lines.beat_before: the old tree at dusk: its branches bow under a weight no one can see

lines.text: Kapag pinutol ang puno at ginawang haligi ng bahay, sumasama raw siya.
lines.beat_before: the tree comes down; then the trunk stands as a post inside a new house

lines.text: At sinumang matulog sa tabi ng haliging iyon, dadaganan niya.
lines.beat_before: the new house at night: a man and his wife asleep under the kulambo by the post; the bark moves

lines.text: Bangungot naman ang tawag ng iba. Sa isang pag-aaral sa Maynila, halos lahat ng namatay sa pagtulog ay mga lalaki. Kadalasan, bandang alas tres ng madaling-araw.
lines.beat_before: the wall clock: 2:59, the minute hand jumps to 3:00; the kulambo sags as weight settles on it

lines.text: Sabi ng mga doktor, may kinalaman ito sa puso at sa paghinga.
lines.beat_before: back in his POV: the face lowers into the frame; his hand trembles at the frame edge

lines.text: Pero kapag nagising ka nang hindi makagalaw, alam mo na ang gagawin. Igalaw mo ang daliri ng paa mo.
lines.beat_before: his big toe in the moonlight, trembling; it moves
he gasps awake; the room is empty; beside him his wife, turned away; her foot: the toe does not move
